text:
alana: Quick heads-up — I uploaded a first draft of the secure-deploy launch one-pager and a companion bench narrative. PTAL: https://drive.redwood/secure-deploy/onepager-draft

mike: Nice — will the one-pager include the SLAs matrix + deploy-mode decision flow? field asks for a 1-page summary for calls.

sanjay: yes, I'm hoping we can show the 99th pct latency targets by model class and a fallback routing example. Can we include a tiny diagram (single row) for Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private fallback?

alana: added a small table for SLAs and a simple routing diagram. The bench narrative has a 3-run summary (latency, cost/token, tail lat). It's intentionally concise so field can paste into emails.

laura: For the webinar/launch post, let's lock on the narrative: "predictable inference economics for regulated customers". We should CTA to the one-pager + sign-up for the enterprise webinar.

evans: (design) I can make a 1:1 slide from the one-pager for the webinar intro. Send final copy by EOD for assets.

alana: routing rules draft for inbound leads is here — thinking we route by deal sticker then append product mode interest. Short sample rules: 
```
if (customer.industry in ["finserv","healthcare"]) => route: sales-enterprise@; tag: security-sla
else if (interest includes "private") => route: solutions@dedicated-team; tag: private-deploy
else => route: growth@; tag: hosted-inbound
```
This keeps handoffs clean for AE + SE.

mike: Can we also tag leads by urgency (pilot vs PoC vs RFP)? A quick field cheat: add `priority: pilot|poc|rfp` and the AE queue filters on that.

alana: added priority field to the doc. Also added short copy variants for outbound: one-liner for CISO, one-liner for infra/platform. Examples: "Run LLM inference with enterprise SLAs and private connect — predictable latency, verifiable audit logs."

laura: We should prepare two webinar segments: 1) bench story + live Q&A with runtime eng, 2) customer readiness + procurement checklist for platform teams. That helps move prospects faster through the funnel.

sanjay: I'll prep the bench slides and a 90s demo of fallback routing during capacity constraints. Need a short script for the demo — can someone draft?

evans: I can storyboard the demo screen. Alana, can you drop the final copy into the design doc `secure-deploy/assets/demo-script.md`?

ops-bot: deploy-bot — asset build succeeded for `onepager-v0.3.pdf` (hash: ab12cd).

alana: perfect. final ask: folks comment on the Drive doc by 3pm PT, I'll consolidate and send to ops for publish cadence. :thumbsup:
